metadata.description: Andy Horn's Claude Code skills, agents, and hooks.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workflows: rebase onto the default or stacked parent branch, driving mechanics on a cheap model and escalating conflict resolution to a strong one.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Working-session workflows: align on a shared understanding before work starts, triage review findings into necessary, beneficial, defer, and discard, then walk the remaining decisions one at a time with docket, and keep a shared domain vocabulary with glossary.

plugins.name: rigor
plugins.description: Session discipline: verify claims, push back, stress-test plans with operator and adversary personas, and grade deliverables 0-100 with a reviewer agent.
